_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment; ADR-031 configuration as records, imperative pre-save check in FieldRequirementListener
_meta.description: FieldRequirement: a field an administration requires on a record type on top of the fields the app always requires. FieldRequirementListener refuses a person's save through the object API that leaves an active requirement empty, and refuses a requirement on a field the record type does not have or already always requires.

FieldRequirement.title: Required field
FieldRequirement.description: A field that must be filled in on a record type in one administration, with the reason.

administrationId.title: Administration ID
administrationId.description: The administration the requirement applies to. Other administrations are not affected.

schema.title: Record type
schema.description: The record type, by its name, for example SupplierInvoice or CustomerMaster.

field.title: Field
field.description: The field that must be filled in, by its name, for example costCenter.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the field is required. Shown to the person whose save is refused.
reason.example: Elke inkoopfactuur wordt op een kostenplaats verantwoord

lifecycleState.title: State
lifecycleState.description: Active requirements are checked on every save; a retired one no longer is.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Who made a field required, retired the requirement or changed its reason, and when.
